However, you asked for this expressed in MWh. I should note that **MAE is an error metric measured in the same units as the target variable** (kW in this case). It is not a quantity that converts directly to MWh—MWh is a unit of energy (power × time), whereas MAE is an instantaneous power error.

If you need the MAE value in its native units, it is **6079.4 kW**.
